sql: INSERT INTO sales_order (order_id, region) VALUES ('X1', '华东')
why: 写操作必须被拒

sql: UPDATE sales_order SET status = 'closed' WHERE order_id = 'SO-1'
why: 写操作必须被拒

sql: DELETE FROM material WHERE category = '半成品'
why: 写操作必须被拒

sql: DROP TABLE sales_order
why: DDL 既非查询也含危险关键字

sql: SELECT o.order_id FROM sales_order o; DROP TABLE material
why: 分号拼接第二条是 DDL

sql: PRAGMA journal_mode = wal
why: PRAGMA 会改连接状态

sql: ATTACH DATABASE 'x.db' AS x
why: ATTACH 挂载外部库

sql: SELECT * FROM sales_order
why: 禁止全列投影

sql: SELECT s.* FROM sales_order s
why: 别名限定 .* 同样禁止

sql: SELECT a.audit_id FROM internal_audit a
why: 禁用表不可查

sql: SELECT s.internal_note FROM sales_order s
why: 禁用字段不可查

sql: SELECT s.customer_phone FROM sales_order s
why: 敏感字段默认禁止

sql: SELECT customer_phone FROM sales_order
why: 未限定字段也要靠词边界扫描拦住

sql: SELECT a.created_at FROM[internal_audit] a
why: FROM 后无空格时正则识别不到表，禁用表会漏网

sql: SELECT randomblob(100000000) AS payload FROM material
why: 资源型函数不在关键字黑名单里

sql: SELECT xp_cmdshell('dir') AS out FROM material
why: 不写 EXEC 的危险函数调用

sql: SELECT o.order_id INTO #tmp FROM sales_order o
why: SELECT INTO 落表不含 INSERT 关键字

sql: SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = 'table'
why: 查系统表绕过目录，正则会报 unknown_table 但语义不对

sql: SELECT TABLE_NAME FROM information_schema.tables
why: 元数据通道必须显式拒绝

sql: EXEC('DELETE FROM material')
why: 写语句藏在 EXEC 字符串里

sql: SELECT o.order_id FROM sales_order o ORDER BY o.order_id OFFSET 10 ROWS FETCH NEXT 10 ROWS ONLY
why: 目标库是 SQL Server 2008 R2

sql: SELECT o.order_id FROM sales_order AS o WITH (NOLOCK)
why: SQLite 没有表提示

sql: SELECT o.order_id FROM sales_order AS o WITH (UPDLOCK)
why: 只允许 NOLOCK，UPDLOCK 会加写锁

sql: SELECT d.lookup_name FROM dim_lookup d
why: 维度表必须限定 lookup_type

sql: SELECT x.from_date FROM delivery_plan x
why: 目录外的表不允许出现

sql: SELECT s.warehouse_zone FROM sales_order s
why: 拼错字段要在执行前拦住

sql: SELECT o.order_id FROM sales_order o JOIN bom_lines b ON b.parent_id = o.order_id
why: JOIN 的表同样要过目录
空 SQL 直接拒

sql: SELECT `order_id` FROM `internal_audit` a
why: 反引号包住的禁用表：掩码器以前不去反引号，表引用读成 0 条，规则整层被跳过

sql: SELECT `o`.`customer_phone` FROM `sales_order` AS `o`
why: 全限定列 + 全引号表名以前同样读不出来，敏感列检查整条跳过

sql: SELECT `t`.`name` FROM `sqlite_master` AS `t`
why: 反引号包系统目录：正则层报 unknown_table（AST 层还会多报 metadata_access）

sql: SELECT o.order_id FROM sales_order o WHERE o.customer_name = 'DROP TABLE material;--'
why: 字符串里的关键字不是 SQL，不能误杀

sql: SELECT /* update sales_order set status='x' */ o.order_id FROM sales_order o
why: 注释里的写关键字不是 SQL

sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM sales_order
why: COUNT(*) 不是全列投影

sql: WITH open_orders AS (SELECT o.order_id FROM sales_order o WHERE o.status = 'open') SELECT COUNT(open_orders.order_id) AS c FROM open_orders
why: CTE 名不参与目录校验

sql: SELECT o.order_id FROM sales_order o WHERE o.region = '华东' AND o.order_date >= '2026-06-01'
why: 中文维度值是正常查询

sql: SELECT d.lookup_code FROM dim_lookup d WHERE d.lookup_type = 'material_category'
why: 带上了必需过滤条件

sql: SELECT o.order_id FROM sales_order AS o WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE o.status = 'open'
why: 只读 NOLOCK 在 SQL Server 是允许的

sql: SELECT TOP 5 o.order_id FROM sales_order AS o ORDER BY o.order_id
why: 2008 R2 的分页写法

sql:
```sql
SELECT o.order_id FROM sales_order o WHERE o.region = '华北'
```
why: 模型常带代码围栏，清洗后要放行

sql: SELECT `o`.`order_id`, `o`.`region` FROM `sales_order` AS `o` WHERE `o`.`region` = '华北' ORDER BY `o`.`order_id` LIMIT 5
why: MySQL 风格反引号是合法标识符引用，去引号后不能反过来误杀正确查询
